title: PerTaskInsightfulnessReport
description: One judge's per-TASK insightfulness report. The judge is given ONE benchmark task and ALL of its agent trajectories at once, and writes a single report-level explanation of what the task–trajectory set teaches us about agent capability, limitation, workflow, or benchmark design. The 9 prose sections map 1:1 to the insightfulness prompt; `insightfulness` is the single fixed verdict. Metadata (task_id, n_trials, benchmark) is copied from /insight/meta.json.

task_id.description: Copied from /insight/meta.json — the Harbor-index task identifier.

n_trials.description: Copied from /insight/meta.json — number of trial trajectories the judge was given for this task.

benchmark.description: Copied from /insight/meta.json — the source benchmark family (e.g. algotune, swebenchverified, gaia2).

insightfulness.description: The single fixed verdict: how insightful, instructional, or enlightening this task (with its trajectories) is for the next generation of agent, model, and benchmark-task design.

tldr.description: Verdict of insightfulness. Briefly summarize the main insight, or explain why the task is not very insightful.

main_insight.description: What does this task–trajectory set reveal about agent capability, limitation, or benchmark design?

why_it_matters.description: Why would this insight be useful for improving future agents, training methods, evaluation design, or benchmark construction?

evidence_from_trajectories.description: What specific agent behaviors support this interpretation? Refer to concrete moments, not vague impressions. Compare across trajectories where multiple are present.

surface_failure_vs_root_cause.description: What is the visible failure, and what deeper cause is most likely behind it?

intended_vs_unexpected_insight.description: Did the agents fail on the capability the task was designed to test, or did the task reveal a different but still valuable bottleneck?

generalizability.description: Would improving this weakness help agents beyond this specific task? Explain why or why not.

confounds.description: Are there reasons to doubt the insight, such as ambiguous instructions, environment issues, verifier problems, missing context, or insufficient trajectory evidence?

implications_for_future_design.description: What does this suggest for future benchmark tasks, agent training, tool-use design, or evaluation protocols?
